describe: The image shows a sci-fi gun seen from the side, pointing left, with a dark steel grey-blue body covered in ribbed vents and small panels. A large round dark red-brown muzzle opening with a glowing rim sits at the left end, and a bright white-pink glow lies below the trigger area. A warm brown grip and bronze accents sit at the lower right. The background is an opaque, mottled pale grey-blue, not transparent, and the lighting is soft and fairly even.
